# A generic component built at run time -- stateful, under a `for` or in a
# recursion -- is copied per instantiation on a target that does not emit a
# generic component, so Go and Kotlin hold each copy's props, events, state
# and methods at the types its call site bound: a `list[T]` prop, and an
# anonymous struct naming T as a prop, an event's parameter, state, what a
# method returns, and a value a handler builds.
# testdata/generic_component_runtime_instance.txtar is the code.
#
# bubbletea splices a stateful component per copy rather than building it, so
# it is not this path: it refuses state in a recursion, a copy's included, and
# the loops' effects reading the loop variable whether or not the component
# is generic.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

# A recursion instantiating itself at a deeper type would need a copy per
# depth, which no build can write down.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform fyne --out out deeper.sngl
stderr 'deeper.sngl:8:\d+: "nest" instantiates itself'

! sngl generate --lang kotlin --platform android --out out2 deeper.sngl
stderr 'deeper.sngl:8:\d+: "nest" instantiates itself'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component show[T any](
    w struct {
        v T
    },
    @seen(v T),
) {
    var hits = 0
    effect(@mount { seen(w.v) })
    ui.button(text="{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

component main ui.node {
    var items = [1, 2]
    var sum = 0
    ui.vbox {
        for var i = items {
            show(w={v=i}, @seen(v) { sum = sum + v })
        }
    }
}

func testEachCopyHoldsItsStruct(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.sum == 3)
}

ui.window(title="x") {
    main
}
-- list.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component show[T any](xs list[T], @seen(n int)) {
    var hits = 0
    effect(@mount { seen(xs.length) })
    ui.button(text="{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

component main ui.node {
    var items = [1, 2]
    var sum = 0
    ui.vbox {
        for var i = items {
            show(xs=[i, i], @seen(n) { sum = sum + n })
        }
    }
}

func testEachCopyHoldsItsList(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.sum == 4)
}

ui.window(title="x") {
    main
}
-- recursive.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component nest[T any](x T, d int, @seen(w struct {
    v T
})) {
    var hits = 0
    effect(@mount { seen({v=x}) })
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button(text="{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        if d > 0 {
            nest(x=x, d=d - 1, @seen(w) { seen(w) })
        }
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var count = 0
    var said = ""
    ui.vbox {
        nest(x=1, d=2, @seen(w) { count = count + w.v })
        nest(x="a", d=1, @seen(w) { said = said + w.v })
    }
}

func testEachLevelHoldsItsStruct(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.count == 3)
    t.assert(c.said == "aa")
}

ui.window(title="x") {
    main
}
-- event.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component pick[T any](x T, @chose(w struct {
    v T
})) {
    var hits = 0
    effect(@mount { chose({v=x}) })
    ui.button(text="{hits}", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
        chose({v=x})
    })
}

component main ui.node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var got = ""
    ui.vbox {
        for var i = items {
            pick(x=i, @chose(w) { got = got + w.v })
        }
    }
}

func testEachCopyHandsOnItsStruct(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.got == "ab")
}

ui.window(title="x") {
    main
}
-- state.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component keep[T any](x T, @seen(v T)) {
    var w = {v=x}
    effect(@mount { seen(w.v) })
    ui.button(text="b", @click { w = {v=x} })
}

component main ui.node {
    var items = [1, 2]
    var sum = 0
    ui.vbox {
        for var i = items {
            keep(x=i, @seen(v) { sum = sum + v })
        }
    }
}

func testEachCopyKeepsItsStruct(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.sum == 3)
}

ui.window(title="x") {
    main
}
-- method.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component pick[T any](x T, @chose(v T)) {
    var hits = 0
    func boxed() struct {
        v T
    } {
        return {v=x}
    }
    effect(@mount {
        var w = boxed()
        chose(w.v)
    })
    ui.button(text="{hits}", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
        var w = boxed()
        chose(w.v)
    })
}

component main ui.node {
    var items = [1, 2]
    var got = 0
    ui.vbox {
        for var i = items {
            pick(x=i, @chose(w) { got = got + w })
        }
    }
}

func testEachCopyReturnsItsStruct(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.got == 3)
}

ui.window(title="x") {
    main
}
-- local.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component pick[T any](x T, @chose(v T)) {
    var hits = 0
    effect(@mount {
        var w = {v=x}
        chose(w.v)
    })
    ui.button(text="{hits}", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
        var w = {v=x}
        chose(w.v)
    })
}

component main ui.node {
    var items = [1, 2]
    var got = 0
    ui.vbox {
        for var i = items {
            pick(x=i, @chose(w) { got = got + w })
        }
    }
}

func testEachCopyBuildsItsStruct(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.got == 3)
}

ui.window(title="x") {
    main
}
-- deeper.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component nest[T any](x T, d int) {
    var hits = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button(text="{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        if d > 0 {
            nest(x=[x], d=d - 1)
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="x") {
    nest(x=1, d=2)
}
